svg.title: Le multivers de mes projets
svg.desc: Mes projets, chacun présenté comme une Terre du multivers : Grimoire du Cœur — French Persona / SMT / Atlus community — I run it; Persona_GRUB_Themes — 70+ bootloader themes for Persona fans; personadle — daily Persona guessing game, 6 modes; kagami — anime hand-signs recognised by your webcam; jojo-arena — 1v1 top-down pixel arena fighter; p2is-relecture — proofreading webapp for the Persona 2 translation; ViscoCrowd — particle simulation of a panicking pool evacuation; five_nights_at_fabron — point-and-click horror survival game
svg.text: every project is its own Earth
